description_expanded: ABOUT BLUE PALM Escape to Blue Palm, a bright and welcoming beach cottage perfectly tucked away in the laid-back community of Inlet Beach, Florida. Just steps from the sparkling turquoise waters of the Gulf, this 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath private home is designed for relaxed coastal living - where morning walks on the sand, sunny afternoons, and slow evenings under the stars become part of your daily rhythm. From the moment you step inside, you'll feel the ease of vacation living. The airy, open-concept floor plan invites connection - whether you're cooking breakfast in the fully equipped kitchen, gathering around the dining table with loved ones, or curling up on the queen sleeper sofa for a movie night. Coastal-inspired décor, natural light, and thoughtful touches make every corner feel like home. Step outside and let the sea breeze guide your day. Fire up the outdoor grill for a backyard cookout, sip your morning coffee on the porch, or grab your beach bag and take a short 5-minute stroll to the sugar-white sands. In the evenings, watch the sky turn cotton-candy pink and gold as the sun sets over the Gulf - it's a view you'll never forget. Whether you're here for a romantic getaway, a family vacation, or a fun trip with friends, Blue Palm offers the perfect blend of charm, comfort, and location. It's more than a vacation rental - it's your personal seaside retreat where memories are made. Book your stay at Blue Palm today and let the beach take care of the rest. ABOUT THE AREA Found along Florida's scenic Highway 30A, Inlet Beach is a charming beach neighborhood perfect for your next getaway. Known for its stunning white sandy beaches, crystal-clear waters, and relaxed atmosphere, Inlet Beach offers a peaceful coastal vacation for visitors seeking a more laid-back experience. This quaint community is characterized by its quiet residential streets lined with beautiful beach cottages and upscale vacation homes, perfect for those looking to unwind and enjoy the natural beauty of the Gulf Coast. When you stay in Inlet Beach, you are never far from the beach or a magnificent view. To explore 30A, take a bike ride to Rosemary Beach to enjoy the farmers market, discover the new 30A Avenue shops, taste local cuisine at popular restaurants, and visit local businesses along 30A. Visitors can also explore the neighboring 30A beach communities of Rosemary Beach, Seacrest Beach, and Alys Beach, each offering unique shopping, dining, and entertainment options. For additional shopping and adventure, take a family drive to Pier Park in Panama City Beach or travel to the Sandestin Outlet shops. Beach provides easy access to a variety of outdoor activities, including swimming, sunbathing, paddleboarding, kayaking, and fishing. The nearby Camp Helen State Park offers nature trails for hiking and birdwatching, while Lake Powell - one of Florida's largest coastal dune lakes - provides opportunities for boating and wildlife viewing. Its pristine beaches, serene ambiance, and proximity to a wealth of things to do, Inlet Beach is a hidden gem along Highway 30A, perfect for those seeking a peaceful retreat on Florida's Gulf Coast. PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: * Beachside of 30A - less than 5-minute walk to the sand * Dog Friendly * Private Home * Fully Equipped Kitchen * 3 Bedrooms + Queen Sleeper Sofa * Smart TVs & WiFi * Outdoor Charcoal Grill * 3 Designated Parking Spots PARKING: * 3 Designated Parking Spots PROPERTY RULES: * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hours of booking or subject to cancellation * Must be 25 years or older to book * Dog-friendly with approval (up to 35 lbs.). Pet fee $250. * Smoking not permitted * All reservations are non-refundable - we strongly encourage purchasing travel insurance to protect your trip ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first-class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained to the highest standard. Our team is local and available 24/7 to ensure your stay is seamless and stress-free. Our mission is to help you create lasting memories, one beach vacation at a time.

Location: Less Than a 5 Minute Walk to the Beach
